cells.scene: An old concrete road surface is deeply pitted with many small depressions, rainwater collected in a few hollows.
An adult reading an unexpected troubling letter has furrowed brows and a worried hand at their chin.
A hiker expects a small gentle hill shown in their simple sketch, but looks up at the much steeper real hill ahead.
A small car abruptly turns away from a fallen branch on the road, curved tire-path marks make the sudden change of direction clear.

prompt:
Use case: scientific-educational. Create ONE SQUARE 2x2 atlas with four equal square cells for an adult vocabulary app. Attached image is STYLE REFERENCE ONLY: restrained ink-and-watercolor educational illustrations, clear dark blue-charcoal outlines, pale blue wash, small warm natural color accents. Pure WHITE opaque background. Central 75% of each quadrant contains its subject with generous margins. Nothing crosses midlines. Leave horizontal 45–55% and vertical 47–53% center bands EMPTY WHITE. Natural human anatomy, recognizable objects, clear 320px silhouettes, restrained detail, no elaborate environment. NO captions, labels, writing, borders, grid lines, watermarks or logos. Only symbols or numerals explicitly requested in a cell are allowed. Meanings are guidance; never write them. Row-major fixed order. FOUR CELLS:
TOP LEFT — pit (v.使得坑坑洼洼): An old concrete road surface is deeply pitted with many small depressions, rainwater collected in a few hollows.
TOP RIGHT — perturb (v.使不安): An adult reading an unexpected troubling letter has furrowed brows and a worried hand at their chin.
BOTTOM LEFT — underestimate (v.低估): A hiker expects a small gentle hill shown in their simple sketch, but looks up at the much steeper real hill ahead.
BOTTOM RIGHT — swerve (v.急转弯): A small car abruptly turns away from a fallen branch on the road, curved tire-path marks make the sudden change of direction clear.
EXTRA CROP SAFETY: Draw noticeably SMALLER compact subjects. Every object, mast, roof, thought bubble and entire person must have an empty white border of at least 12% of its quadrant on ALL FOUR sides. Top row ends above 44% canvas height; bottom row starts below 58%. Never let a background tower extend upward into the midline. No part is clipped by a quadrant edge.
review_notes: Reviewed selected course meanings, anatomy, scale and white crop margins. Primitive is a prehistoric living scene; rough is uneven rocky terrain; pit is a pitted road; underestimate contrasts a mild imagined hill with an actual steep climb; swerve shows an abrupt evasive curve.
